mapper.sql: registration_opens_at AS registrationOpensAt, registration_closes_at AS registrationClosesAt, correction_closes_at AS correctionClosesAt, qualification_closes_at AS qualificationClosesAt, submission_opens_at AS submissionOpensAt, submission_closes_at AS submissionClosesAt, judging_opens_at AS judgingOpensAt, judging_closes_at AS judgingClosesAt

id, competition_no AS competitionNo, name, edition, rules_text AS rulesText, organizer_id AS organizerId, entry_mode AS entryMode, min_team_size AS minTeamSize, max_team_size AS maxTeamSize, , scoring_rubric AS scoringRubric, required_judges AS requiredJudges, status, row_version AS rowVersion, cancellation_reason AS cancellationReason, current_publication_id AS currentPublicationId

CASE WHEN status = 'DRAFT' THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN current_publication_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'RESULTS' WHEN #{now} < registration_opens_at THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN #{now} < registration_closes_at THEN 'REGISTRATION' WHEN #{now} < qualification_closes_at THEN 'QUALIFICATION' WHEN #{now} < submission_opens_at THEN 'AWAITING_SUBMISSION' WHEN #{now} < submission_closes_at THEN 'SUBMISSION' WHEN #{now} < judging_opens_at THEN 'AWAITING_JUDGING' WHEN #{now} < judging_closes_at THEN 'JUDGING' ELSE 'AWAITING_RESULTS' END
mapper.select: SELECT FROM competition WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO competition(competition_no, name, edition, rules_text, organizer_id, entry_mode, min_team_size, max_team_size, registration_opens_at, registration_closes_at, correction_closes_at, qualification_closes_at, submission_opens_at, submission_closes_at, judging_opens_at, judging_closes_at, scoring_rubric, required_judges) VALUES(#{competitionNo}, #{name}, #{edition}, #{rulesText}, #{organizerId}, #{entryMode}, #{minTeamSize}, #{maxTeamSize}, #{registrationOpensAt}, #{registrationClosesAt}, #{correctionClosesAt}, #{qualificationClosesAt}, #{submissionOpensAt}, #{submissionClosesAt}, #{judgingOpensAt}, #{judgingClosesAt}, #{scoringRubric}, #{requiredJudges})
mapper.sql: registration_opens_at = #{registrationOpensAt}, registration_closes_at = #{registrationClosesAt}, correction_closes_at = #{correctionClosesAt}, qualification_closes_at = #{qualificationClosesAt}, submission_opens_at = #{submissionOpensAt}, submission_closes_at = #{submissionClosesAt}, judging_opens_at = #{judgingOpensAt}, judging_closes_at = #{judgingClosesAt}
mapper.update: UPDATE competition SET name = #{name}, edition = #{edition}, rules_text = #{rulesText}, entry_mode = #{entryMode}, min_team_size = #{minTeamSize}, max_team_size = #{maxTeamSize}, , scoring_rubric = #{scoringRubric}, required_judges = #{requiredJudges}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE competition SET , row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE competition SET status = #{status}, cancellation_reason = #{reason}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM competition WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_assignment a JOIN submission_version v ON v.id = a.submission_version_id JOIN submission s ON s.id = v.submission_id JOIN registration r ON r.id = s.registration_id WHERE r.competition_id = #{competitionId} AND a.judge_id = #{actorId} AND a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','SUBMITTED'))

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS registrations, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approved, COUNT(s.id) AS submissions, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.eligibility_status='ELIGIBLE' AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment a WHERE a.submission_version_id = s.locked_version_id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') = c.required_judges THEN 1 END) AS scored FROM competition c LEFT JOIN registration r ON r.competition_id = c.id LEFT JOIN submission s ON s.registration_id = r.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id AS publicationId, p.version_no AS versionNo, p.no_awards AS noAwards, p.published_at AS publishedAt FROM competition c JOIN result_publication p ON p.id = c.current_publication_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED','ARCHIVED')
mapper.sql: FROM competition c JOIN result_publication p ON p.id = c.current_publication_id WHERE c.status IN ('PUBLISHED','ARCHIVED')
mapper.select: SELECT r.publication_id AS publicationId, r.work_title_snapshot AS workTitle, r.entry_display_snapshot AS entryDisplay, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.award_name AS awardName, r.recipient_names_snapshot AS recipientNames FROM competition_result r WHERE r.outcome_status = 'RANKED' AND r.award_name IS NOT NULL AND r.publication_id IN #{publicationId} ORDER BY r.publication_id, r.rank_no, r.registration_id
